verdict.description: PASS: no critical/high issues. PASS_WITH_NOTES: medium/low deferred. FAIL: critical/high unresolved.

issues_found.description: All usability issues found during review.

description.description: Specific description of the usability issue.

screen.description: Screen or component where the issue was found.

principle_violated.description: Which principle, heuristic, or decision rule this violates.

resolution.description: How the issue was resolved (required when action is 'fixed').

critical_unresolved.description: Count of critical-severity issues not yet resolved. Must be 0 for PASS.

high_unresolved.description: Count of high-severity issues not yet resolved. Must be 0 for PASS.

checklist_completed.description: True if Usability_Checklist.md has been completed and signed off.

ready_for_handoff.description: True if verdict is PASS or PASS_WITH_NOTES and checklist is completed.
